title: The Patient Room
author: Odile Sterling
blurb: Dominic Iversen, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the harvest moon rises.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
